Read SLS (Sector Level) File

Source: R/read_sls.R
read_sls.Rd

This function parses SAAM/Airspace Editor .sls files which define the composition of sectors by mapping them to specific volumes (airblocks) and defining vertical limits.

The file structure is defined as follows:

  • Extension: sls

  • Origin: Airspace Editor

  • Separator: Blank (whitespace)

  • Sort: Grouped by sector name

Functionality: The file links sectors to volumes defined in the ARE (ASCII Region) file.

The file consists of rows with the following fields:

  1. sector_id: Sector name (Max 19 chars).

  2. volume_sign: Always "+" (indicates the volume is added to the sector).

  3. volume_id: Refers to the name of the volume in the ARE file (max 24 chars).

  4. fl_bottom: Flight Level (FL), overwrites the level in the ARE file.

  5. fl_top: Flight Level (FL), overwrites the level in the ARE file.

Note: Meta lines supported in previous SLS formats are not supported in this parser. Use SPC format for metadata.

Usage

read_sls(sls_file)

Arguments

sls_file

Path to the .sls file.

Value

A data.table containing sector definitions with columns:

  • sector_id: The identifier for the sector.

  • volume_sign: The inclusion flag (should be "+").

  • volume_id: The identifier for the airblock/volume.

  • fl_bottom: The lower vertical limit (Flight Level).

  • fl_top: The upper vertical limit (Flight Level).

Details

Reads the .sls file defining sector vertical limits and airblock mapping.
